properties.displayName: UAV S113 - Target Track Lock Hijack (Unauthorized Track Target Substitution)
properties.description: UAVC4I_CL에서 동일 UnitCallsign에 대해 5분 내 서로 다른 TargetId가 2개 이상 할당되는 추적 표적 전환(락 탈취) 버스트를 탐지. UAVOpmode_CL은 존재하지 않으며 UAVTelemetry_CL에는 표적추적 필드가 없어, C4I 표적 핸드오프 로그(TargetId/UnitCallsign/IssuedBy)를 사용해 재구성. MITRE: T0831 Manipulation of Control (추적 락 대상을 비인가로 전환시켜 무장 오사격 위험 유발)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVC4I_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where isnotempty(TargetId) and isnotempty(UnitCallsign)
| summarize DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetId), TargetList = make_set(TargetId), IssuedByList = make_set(IssuedBy),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UnitCallsign, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DistinctTargets >= 2
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("추적표적_비인가전환_", tostring(DistinctTargets), "개_", UnitCallsign)
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, UnitCallsign, DistinctTargets, TargetList, IssuedByList, TriggerReason
| order by FirstSeen desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S113 - Target Track Lock Hijack (Unauthorized Track Target Substitution) - {{UAVId}}
